replaceRecipes.name: Coca-Cola Molasses Crinkle Cookies
replaceRecipes.book: Sally's Baking Addiction (Seriously Soft Molasses Cookies), reworked for cola
replaceRecipes.method:
prep: Reduce Coca-Cola to molasses strength: 141 g syrup per liter of Coke; cool (see notes)
prep: Heat oven to 350°F; line sheets with parchment
creamed = cream until light and fluffy, 3 min <- Butter + Dark Brown Sugar + Granulated Sugar @dough + Lime Zest @dough + Orange Zest
wet = beat in, scraping the bowl <- creamed + Eggs + Reduced Coca-Cola Syrup + Vanilla Extract + Acid Phosphate Solution
dry = whisk <- Flour + Baking Soda + Baking Powder + Salt + Ground Cinnamon + Ground Ginger + Ground Nutmeg + Ground Coriander + Ground Cloves
dough = mix on low just until combined; chill 1 h <- wet + dry
limeSugar = rub together <- Granulated Sugar @coating + Lime Zest @coating
balls = roll 32 g balls; coat generously in the lime sugar <- dough + limeSugar
bake 350°F 10–11 min, until puffed and cracked with soft centers; cool 5 min on sheet <- balls
replaceRecipes.notes:
COLA SYRUP: Mexican Coke has ~110 g sugar per liter; reducing each liter to ~141 g (≈100 ml) matches molasses' ~22% water. Weigh the empty pot, simmer flat Coke in stainless or enameled (not aluminum/cast iron), and reduce until it weighs 141 g per liter started (2 L → ~282 g); it will bubble around 225°F near the end but trust the scale.
COLA FLAVOR: lime and orange zest, cinnamon, nutmeg, coriander and extra vanilla are classic cola flavorings; cloves and ginger are kept low so it doesn't read as gingerbread. ⅛ tsp orange or lime extract can replace the orange zest; a drop of cola flavoring pushes it further.
ACID PHOSPHATE: stands in for molasses' tang. Start at 1 tsp per batch, taste the dough, go up to 2 tsp. Some of it reacts with the baking soda for a little extra lift.
CRINKLES: the sugar coating plus the puff-and-settle in the oven make the cracks. If a sheet comes out smooth, rap the pan on the counter and bake 1 min more. If the dough chilled longer than 2 h, let it sit 30 min before rolling.
TEXTURE: butter creamed well, ~20 g more flour than Sally's, baking powder alongside the soda, and a 1 h chill make it puffier and softer than a flat chewy molasses cookie.
